## POST `/api/2.29/syslog-servers`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Configure a new syslog server.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the unique name specified. Enter multiple names in comma-separated format. For example, `name01,name02`. |

**Request body** (required): `SyslogServerPost`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `uri` | string | The URI of the syslog server in the format PROTOCOL://HOSTNAME:PORT. |
| `services` | array of string | Valid values are `data-audit` and `management`. If not specified, defaults to `management`. |
| `sources` | array of `_reference` | The network interfaces used for communication with the syslog server. The network interfaces must have the `services` value of `data`. Only network interfaces within default array realm are supported. |

**Responses:** `200` Returns the newly configured syslog server. → `SyslogServerResponse`
